display.purpose: The empty-viewer heading only. The one place type is allowed to be large.

title.purpose: Panel headings, inspector title, timeline heading, clip labels.

body.purpose: Controls, field values and labels. The default voice.

label.purpose: Catalog group headings, inspector section headings, track-section bands.

timecode.purpose: Transport and timeline readouts. Tabular figures, never prose.

mono-small.purpose: Ruler labels, clip durations, track IDs and targets, hex values.

shadows.name: clip-edge-presence
shadows.purpose: Describes a presence clip's edge against its tone. Not lift.

shadows.name: clip-edge-animation
shadows.purpose: Edge on animation pills; uses tone-fx-line.

shadows.name: selection-ring
shadows.purpose: The only outer shadow in the system: the selected clip's hot ring.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background, border and colour changes on buttons and fields. The only duration in the system.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Active-state nudge on buttons. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion disables every transition and the press nudge.

components.name: Render Button
components.description: shadcn Button, default variant, size sm: the one vermilion control in the window.
components.html: <button class="ds-render"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M7 4v16l13-8z"/></svg>Render</button>
components.css: .ds-render { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; min-width: 96px; justify-content: center; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #b6341f; color: #fafafa; font: 600 13px/1 'Inter Variable', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: default; } .ds-render:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, #b6341f 90%, transparent); }

components.name: Toolbar Ghost Button
components.description: shadcn Button, ghost variant in muted-foreground, lifting to foreground with the accent fill on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-ghost"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M19 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h11l5 5v11a2 2 0 0 1-2 2z"/></svg>Save</button>
components.css: .ds-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #62626c; font: 500 13px/1 'Inter Variable', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ghost:hover { background: #ececef; color: #09090b; }

components.name: Field
components.description: shadcn Input at 32px inside the inspector's label grid; the label is muted, the value is foreground.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #62626c; font: 500 13px/1.45 'Inter Variable', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .05); color: #09090b; font: inherit; font-weight: 400; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #9f9fa9; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, #9f9fa9 50%, transparent); }

components.name: State Badge
components.description: shadcn Badge, outline; a vermilion dot marks unsaved work or a stale preview.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 999px; color: #09090b; font: 500 12px/1.4 'Inter Variable', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #b6341f; }

components.name: Shortcut Tooltip
components.description: shadcn Tooltip: an inverted chip naming the action, with its shortcut in Kbd.
components.css: .ds-tip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: #09090b; color: #fafafa; font: 400 12px/1 'Inter Variable', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tip kbd { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / .2); font: 500 12px/1 'Inter Variable', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Object Pool Tile
components.description: Outline tile on card with shadow-xs: a black 16:10 thumbnail holding a drawn glyph over the name.
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; width: 84px; padding: 4px 4px 5px; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .05); color: #09090b; font: 500 12px/1.4 'Inter Variable', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-tile:hover { background: #ececef; } .ds-thumb { display: grid; place-items: center; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; border-radius: 6px; background: #000; }

components.name: Presence Clip
components.description: Timeline clip tinted by object kind, 6px radius, mono duration; the 2px vermilion ring marks the target of Delete.
components.css: .ds-clip { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 320px; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: #6b5aa6; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #b6341f; font: 500 12px/1 'Inter Variable', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dur { font-family: 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 10.5px; opacity: .85; }

components.name: Animation Clip
components.description: Neutral zinc pill with a drawn motion glyph and 'Name · duration'.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 120px; height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: #3f3f45; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #26262b; color: #fff; font: 500 12px/1 'Inter Variable', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Selected Track Label
components.description: Track header in the sticky 176px label column; the accent wash marks the selection and what belongs to it.
components.css: .ds-track { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 176px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid #e4e4e7; background: #ececef; color: #09090b; font: 500 13px/1 'Inter Variable', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-id { width: 24px; font-family: 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #62626c; }

components.name: Playhead
components.description: 1px vermilion line with a 13px pentagon head that lives in the sticky ruler.
components.css: .ds-ruler { position: relative; width: 240px; height: 60px; background: #f4f4f5; } .ds-head { position: absolute; left: 80px; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 1px; background: #b6341f; } .ds-head::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -6px; top: 0; width: 13px; height: 13px; background: #b6341f; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 55%, 50% 100%, 0 55%); }

components.name: Discard Dialog
components.description: shadcn AlertDialog, small and centred: Cancel focused first, a destructive Discard; only when work would be lost.
components.html:
Discard unsaved changes?

“Pythagoras” has changes that are not saved to a file. They will be lost.
components.css: .ds-alert { display: grid; gap: 8px; width: 320px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / .1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / .1); text-align: center; color: #09090b; font: 400 13px/1.45 'Inter Variable', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-alert strong { font-size: 18px; } .ds-alert p { margin: 0; color: #62626c; } .ds-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-actions button { height: 32px; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 13px/1 'Inter Variable', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-cancel { border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .05); } .ds-discard { border: 0; background: #e7000b; color: #fff; }

narrative.northStar: The Edit Suite for Mathematics, built from shadcn/ui
narrative.overview: An edit-suite frame (pool, black viewer, inspector, a timeline band) assembled from shadcn/ui new-york components on the zinc base, with Inter, 8px controls and soft focus rings. Vermilion is shadcn's primary, so it marks Render, the playhead and selection; clip colour encodes object kind; data is set in Cascadia Mono.
keyCharacteristics: shadcn/ui components for every control, owned in src/components/ui.
Panels on 1px seams; only transient surfaces float.
Clip colour encodes object kind; animation clips are zinc pills with a motion glyph.
Timecode and measurement are monospaced, tabular data.
The window draws its own title bar and opens on a Projects screen after a short launch animation of the logo.

rules.name: The One Brand Colour Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is shadcn's primary and appears only on Render / Cancel, the playhead, selection rings, the selected animation's outline, the unsaved and stale dots, and the timeline timecode.

rules.name: The Tone Means Kind Rule
rules.body: A clip's colour is decided by what the object is, never by state; state is the ring, hatching and lock.

rules.name: The Ring Means Target Rule
rules.body: The 2px vermilion ring marks what Delete and the arrow keys act on; the accent wash marks what belongs to it.

rules.name: The Data Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Time, duration, track IDs, hex colours and LaTeX are set in Cascadia Mono with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Regions Stay Flat Rule
rules.body: Panels, the timeline and the inspector never become floating cards; only dialogs and tooltips float, with shadcn's own shadows.

dos: Add controls with the shadcn CLI and fix its cn import to @/lib/cn.
Style shadcn components with utility classes; style.css sits in the components layer.
Keep vermilion to Render / Cancel, the playhead, selection, the unsaved and stale dots and the timeline timecode.
Colour new element kinds with an existing tone by family; give new animations a pill with a drawn glyph.
Set times, durations, IDs, hex values and LaTeX in Cascadia Mono with tabular figures.
Keep the ruler, lane and playhead insets (10px start, 16px end) in sync.
Confirm only when work would be lost; undoable edits never ask.
Add render and video choices to contracts/render-options.json first; TypeScript and Python both read it.
Do keep every title-bar control a button, input or menu so the drag region skips it.
donts: Don't turn regions into floating cards or add shadows beyond shadcn's own.
Don't introduce a second accent colour or use vermilion for links, badges, hover or focus.
Don't recolour clips to show state.
Don't use stock AI iconography (sparkles, wands, robots) or emoji.
Don't put the timeline back under a stacked sidebar of forms.
Don't use uppercase kickers, eyebrows or display type outside the empty viewer, the Projects heading and the launch animation.
Don't paint the stage any colour but the scene's background (black by default).
Don't read the Close button's system red as a second brand colour; it is Windows' own.
